purpose: Universal discovery index for new chats and AI agents working on World_server

serialGrowthEngine.northStar: Every episode should make the viewer want to enter the same real playable world now.

chatgptGameControl.displayName: ChatGPT -> Game Control / Manual Fast Lane

verifiedLinkDelivery.displayName: Verified Link Delivery / Cloudflare exact-revision gate
verifiedLinkDelivery.topology: Builder -> Fleet PRE -> Ocean -> Fleet POST

szh.scope: Personal authored writing for Mikhail: drafting, rewriting, shortening, developing and polishing while preserving a live uneven human voice.
szh.precedence: Latest explicit user edit > current explicit style instruction > SZH canonical doc > machine rules > generic writing conventions
szh.learningRule: Compare user edits to AI drafts and infer candidate transformations, but update the canonical SZH only after explicit user instruction.
szh.discoveryRule: Open SZH.md directly before relying on GitHub code search; a zero-result search is not evidence that SZH is absent.

tedMediaReadiness.scope: Evidence-backed readiness of World_server to support a credible globally interesting, reproducible product/research story and a concise public proof.
tedMediaReadiness.scoreSemantics: Not a probability of TED/TEDx/conference/media acceptance. Score can rise only with new evidence and may fall after regression or invalidated evidence.

prokopiyMinecraftImport.scope: 100% source-tree analysis with selective IMPORT / ADAPT / LEARN-REIMPLEMENT / PRESERVE-FOR-LATER / SKIP disposition, exact provenance, canonical World Server consumers and VNO source-vs-import audit.
prokopiyMinecraftImport.ownerVerdictRule: SUCCESS/FAILURE is set only by the project owner after review; inventory/audit PASS is not a product verdict.

agentBootstrapRule: When a project-specific term is unknown in the current chat, read AI_START_HERE.md and this index from master before asking the user to define it. For manual World_server changes read CHATGPT_GAME_CONTROL.md, data/manual-delivery-policy.json, and data/cloudflare-deployment-identity.json. For serial or player-acquisition content work read the Serial Growth Engine contract and continuity state. For a change-and-link request activate LINK_COMPLETION_LOOP and do not terminate with a progress report while resolvable work remains; final URLs must pass delivery:verify against the repo-derived Cloudflare identity and exact deployed SHA. For personal authored writing for Mikhail, or when an SZH alias is used, read docs/SZH_SYSTEM_RU.md and .ai/szh-writing-system.json before drafting; agents may run node scripts/szh-context.js --prompt to obtain the executable context. Later user edits are stronger calibration evidence, but the canonical rules must not change without explicit user instruction. For TED/global-media/world-significance work, read docs/TED_MEDIA_READINESS_RU.md, .ai/ted-media-readiness.json and data/ted-media-readiness.json; use the existing AKA loop and never invent a second automation stack or readiness delta without evidence. For Prokopiy/Minecraft-import work, read docs/PROKOPIY_MINECRAFT_IMPORT.md plus the provenance capability/import/VNO manifests before proposing new voxel, generation, LIGHT, physics, creature or asset systems; reuse canonical World Server consumers and never infer owner SUCCESS/FAILURE from audit PASS.
